digest.component_or_area: Quality audit remediation: CI reliability, code structure, typing, and user docs
propositions: CI test_opcert_service_app fails intermittently under xdist with pytest teardown race condition (OSError at worker cleanup under host contention)
Existing documentation example teaches assignee identifier inconsistent with docs/config.md Jira resolution rules
Near-cap modules (structured_run, compact, event_append) mix responsibilities across layers causing high complexity; must decompose by layer and centralize duplicated infrastructure
Graph traversal functions (_find_direct_blockers, _get_all_blocked_by, check_cycle_at_level, detect_newly_unblocked) exceed target CCN due to duplicated BFS loops across four call sites
src/rebar/attest package contains untyped function definitions violating strict mypy ratchet policy
